verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Lago describes itself as a "real-time monetization platform" that turns usage into customer-specific pricing, and it offers per-customer custom revenue dashboards. Webhooks exist, but none are shown tied to usage or spend thresholds, and nothing documents a current-cycle accrued-cost view for customers or team. Missing for 10: a documented current-usage/accrued-cost view or API for the open billing period, customer-facing usage visibility, usage or spend thresholds, pre-invoice alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
